name: Telegram-WhatsApp Bridge Bot
description: Bridge bot to forward messages from Telegram to WhatsApp

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI (Get from MongoDB Atlas - mongodb+srv://username:password@cluster.mongodb.net/dbname)

TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: Telegram API ID (default 6 for standard Telegram Desktop)

TELEGRAM_PHONE.description: Your Telegram Phone Number with country code (e.g. +923001234567)

DEFAULT_TARGET.description: Default WhatsApp target number or Group Name (e.g. 923001234567 or Work Group)
